module_summary: AXI4 FIFO wrapper that instantiates a write-side FIFO (buffering W beats in RAM, passing AW/B) and a read-side FIFO (buffering R beats, passing AR).

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data beats buffered by the write-channel FIFO.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data drained from the read-channel FIFO to the slave side.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address passed through write FIFO to master side.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address passed through read FIFO to master side.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: W valid pushing beats into the write FIFO RAM.

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: W ready reflecting write FIFO space.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: R valid from read FIFO output stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Slave R ready popping the read FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data drained from the write FIFO to downstream.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Downstream read data pushed into the read FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Master W valid when write FIFO holds data.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master R ready reflecting read FIFO space.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AW valid passed through the write FIFO block.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: AW ready from write FIFO block.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid passed back to slave side.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AR valid passed through read FIFO block.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR ready from read FIFO block.

groups.name: write_fifo
groups.description: Write-channel FIFO instance buffering W beats, passing AW and B.

groups.name: read_fifo
groups.description: Read-channel FIFO instance buffering R beats, passing AR.
